scope: All active editorial lines from current main registry screened after verifying the 2 Nov Global Macro already QA-approved and publicly bundled. Screening combines the 2 Nov Asia manufacturing evidence and primary OPEC+ 1 Nov, WHO 23 Oct, FAO InFARM, World Bank/IFC 15 Oct, IEA and latest monetary sources. It does not establish that no other event occurred.

reviewed_lines.note: MT-GM-2026-11-02 r1 is QA-approved and publicly bundled on main (37fac002). Asian October PMIs: Korea 51.3, Japan 53.3, Taiwan 54.9; China official 49.3 versus private 52.0. No duplicate daily item.
Asia PMI and Korean customs receipts do not establish cross-border wealth flows or beneficial ownership. Weekly research belongs to 2/5.
China official/private PMI divergence and Korea/Japan deceleration do not alone demonstrate an enduring institutional or social transition; require repeated surveys and physical output.
Country-level survey contrasts for China, Korea, Japan and Taiwan were incorporated in the Global Macro; no new country dossier without deeper structural delta.
Korean semiconductor receipts and PMI dispersion do not independently demonstrate a new technical capability, utilization, or AI deployment efficiency.
AI capex profitability and grid commissioning remain unverified; Korean electrical equipment export signal already staged on 1 Nov; no monthly duplication.
OPEC+ Nov 1 required production decision does not prove physical tanker flows or conflict escalation; no new verified conflict-system shift.
OPEC+ announced collective requirements and WB/IFC investment framework, but no new evidence of beneficial control or strategic actor network beyond named official roles.
BoJ 30 Oct policy rate 1.25%, Fed/ECB latest dated decisions and cross-border credit transmission are treated in 2 Nov macro; no separate new central-bank decision established at cutoff.
OPEC+ 1 Nov official communiqué maintained September 2026 required production for December; decision is institutional, not evidence of delivered barrels. No second piece.
World Bank/Japan DRIVE 15 Oct financing announcement is a facility commitment, not a measured impact or evaluated policy experiment.
No independently documented new monetary-market design or causal policy trial; China survey divergence is not a market-design experiment.
PMIs, Korean trade and IFC up-to-$50m investment commitment are not ownership-resolved monthly wealth stocks.
No newly comparable annual beneficial-ownership or strategic-reserve census; preserve yearly product discipline.
OPEC+ decision and WB/Japan DRIVE are official institutional actions but no newly evidenced governance redesign or systemic outcome today.
Asia supply-chain finance under DRIVE is not a new regional integration treaty; separate committed financing from targets.
PMI and chip export figures cannot quantify labor displacement, access, distribution or other social effects of AI.
FAO September food price index is older than today's cutoff; no new 2 Nov primary comparable nutrition/pesticide exposure or food-affordability evidence for a thematic report.

FAO InFARM 2026 submission window remains open through 30 Nov for 2015–2025 animal/food AMR data; not yet a new harmonized outcome series. No verified new pesticide, herd management or biological/chemical weapons governance delta.
War escalation is conditional; no independently verified 2 Nov military deployment or imminent major-power war signal established. Oil logistics risks remain scenario, not fact.
WHO 23 Oct Bundibugyo Ebola update documented 9,704 confirmed cases/4,687 deaths as of 20 Oct; 26 Oct thematic already staged and must not be duplicated. No new 2 Nov verified surveillance vintage.
No new archival primary documents or historical reappraisal supported by today's macro releases; avoid repackaging historical corpus.
OPEC+ 1 Nov required output unchanged for December, not physical supply. IEA grid queues and Korea export equipment signal require project-level deployment before separate industrial assessment.
US midterm voting scheduled 3 Nov is future at cutoff; no outcome or new official fiscal decision inferred. Prior Brazil election corpus not duplicated.
No new dated primary reserve certification, resource ownership transfer or access-control change; distinguish strategic scarcity scenarios from established events.
Korean electrical equipment sales and IEA grid queue estimates do not prove installed MW, Itaipu-specific policy or commissioned datacenter grid access.
Asian factory survey and OPEC+ decision indicate exposure channels but no new independently measured 2 Nov port, tanker or rail throughput.
IEA October oil balances, FAO food prices and WHO preparedness evidence lack a harmonized 2 Nov comparable inventory for energy, food, minerals and medical reserves.

additional_thematic_reason: No distinct 2 Nov primary evidence delta sufficient for a second fully sourced bilingual research item: Asia PMI/OPEC+ already in macro; WHO Ebola already staged; AMR reporting window and DRIVE financing do not yet supply observed outcome data.

limitations: Screening is bounded by releases accessible by the 05:12 BRT review; not a complete worldwide real-time incident feed.

No independent 2 Nov cross-border livestock AMR outcomes, pesticide-exposure statistics, clinical Ebola incidence update or physical oil cargo delivery series was found in the checked primary sources.
The daily Global Macro was already approved and public at this run's HEAD, so no producer re-staging or QA handoff was necessary.
No claim that external deploy has occurred; only public repository bundle verified.
